description: Polymer mini HTML file defining core Polymer features, including template preparation, content distribution, and DOM API extensions.

classes.name: Polymer.DomApi
classes.description: Provides a wrapper around DOM nodes with extended methods for Polymer features.

classes.name: Polymer.DomApi.ClassList
classes.description: Wrapper for classList property with Polymer-specific methods.

classes.name: Polymer.DomApi.EffectiveNodesObserver
classes.description: Observes effective DOM nodes, including shadow DOM and content distribution.

classes.name: Polymer.DomApi.DistributedNodesObserver
classes.description: Specialized observer for distributed nodes in shadow DOM.

methods.name: _prepTemplate
methods.description: Prepares the template, importing and decorating it.

methods.name: _stampTemplate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the template content.

methods.name: instanceTemplate
methods.description: Returns a cloned DOM node from the template.

methods.name: attachedCallback
methods.description: Handles attachment lifecycle, triggering distribution if needed.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes pending DOM operations and debouncers.

methods.name: addStaticFlush
methods.description: Adds a static function to be called during flush.

methods.name: addDebouncer
methods.description: Adds a debouncer for batching DOM updates.

methods.name: _createLocalRoot
methods.description: Creates a shadow root or local DOM root for the element.
